title: Vietnamese Sizzling Chicken Crepes
description: A crispy and savory Vietnamese-inspired crepe filled with juicy chicken, perfect for a quick snack or meal. The combination of spices and herbs adds a delightful flavor to this sizzling dish.

ingredients.name: Eggs
ingredients.notes: Large eggs for a tender crepe

instructions: In a large bowl, combine flour and eggs. Gradually add water and mix until smooth.
Heat a small non-stick pan over medium heat. Brush with vegetable oil.
Pour in the batter and tilt the pan to evenly coat the bottom.
Cook for 2 minutes or until the edges start to curl. Loosen with a spatula and flip.
Cook for another minute or until golden brown.
In a separate pan, heat some oil and cook the chicken until cooked through.
Add sizzling sauce and stir to combine.
Fill the crepe with the chicken mixture and garnish with fried shallots.
